caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 12.1 of the Security Policy and operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy.
description: The Tigera Cryptographic Module is a general-purpose cryptographic module integrated in Tigera’s products to provide FIPS 140-2 validated cryptography for the protection of sensitive information.

Ubuntu Linux 18.04 running on Google Arcadia-Rome with AMD Rome with PAA
Ubuntu Linux 18.04 running on Google Arcadia-Rome with AMD Rome without PAA
Ubuntu Linux 18.04 running on Zaius P9 with POWER9 with PAA
Ubuntu Linux 18.04 running on Zaius P9 with POWER9 without PAA (single-user mode).
